failure_summary.description: Several calls differed from expected parameter values, casing, or required-versus-optional placement.
Some trajectories chose a broad or mismatched endpoint instead of one aligned to the requested lookup or check.
Airport-related operations were either replaced by a broad catalog lookup or omitted from a chronological task summary.
A trajectory added overlapping validators beyond the distinct checks requested.

patch.reasoning: The skill already addresses schema binding, endpoint matching, and avoiding redundant calls, so repeating those rules would not fill a gap. It does not explicitly guard against omitting operations merely because they are narrated as past actions, or against substituting an unfiltered catalog for a lookup of named entities.

edits.content: - Build a coverage ledger from every distinct requested action and target, even when the query recounts actions in past-tense or chronological form; do not omit an operation merely because it is narrated as already performed. For a named-entity lookup, prefer an endpoint that searches or resolves that entity; use an unfiltered catalog only when the user asks for the full catalog or it is the only supported way to satisfy the request.
